column2: [intro]
I smoked my last pack in thirty minutes flat,
I said, "That’s enough, I need to quit just like that!"
My lungs are on strike, they're protesting the strain,
But I don’t care, I crave that nicotine again.
I smoked my last pack in thirty minutes flat,
I live life to the fullest, pushing limits like that.
The smoke surrounds me, I float in the haze,
I’m the nicotine prince, ruling the craze.
I light up another cigarette without delay,
I’m hooked, I can admit, I’m addicted this way.
In my closet, packs stacked high with no end,
I’m immune to the anti-smoking campaign trend.
My health takes a hit, that’s a fact for sure,
But I’d rather burn the candle at both ends, pure.
When I smoke, I feel vibrant and alive,
Nothing will stop this fire that makes me thrive.
